title: tm.ttni 0.1.0
text: Initial TTNI table builder using tern / rtables. Automatic two-arm vs multi-arm detection via detect_arm_design(). Hazard ratio, Wald CI, log-rank p-value calculated two-arm designs. Multi-arm / dose-level tables keep event counts, Kaplan-Meier quartiles, follow-time, landmark rates. Teal module uses teal.transform PARAMCD selection, shinyvalidate, -data path, Show R Code. build_ttni_table() accepts prepped object server prepares data . Synthetic fixtures expose subject-level ADSL BDS ADTTE (TTNI + OS). demo HR-example uses public CDISC Pilot three-arm study; synthetic multi-arm labels generic (Arm / Arm B / Arm C). Interactive tables omit method footnotes default; definitions README. Pass default_ttni_footnotes() TFL-style footer. Time--event statistics include descriptive Mean (SD) AVAL. Median 95% CI always one median_ci_3d row. Quartiles range labeled Q1, Q3 Min, Max. CDISC Pilot / random.cdisc.data adapters via standardize_adsl() standardize_adtte().
